description: ATS systems scan for keywords matching the job description. Tailor your resume to each role by mirroring language from the job posting.
tips: Use standard section headers (Experience, Education, Skills)
Include measurable accomplishments, not just responsibilities
Keep it to 1-2 pages; 1 page for <5 years experience
Avoid graphics, tables, or unusual fonts that confuse ATS parsers
Use common role titles (e.g., 'Software Engineer' not 'Code Wizard')

description: Typically 30-45 minutes with a recruiter or hiring manager. Goal: confirm basic fit on experience, motivation, and communication.
tips: Have a 2-minute 'tell me about yourself' polished
Know your resume cold — be ready to expand on any bullet
Research the company: funding stage, products, recent news
Prepare 3 thoughtful questions about the role
Test your audio/video setup 10 minutes beforehand

description: Tests core technical competence via coding, case studies, or take-home assignments.
tips: Read the problem fully before writing code
Communicate your thought process clearly
Write clean, readable code — not just code that passes
Handle edge cases explicitly
Ask clarifying questions; assumptions should be stated

description: Evaluates soft skills, cultural fit, and past behavior patterns using STAR method questions.
tips: Prepare 6-8 STAR stories that can flex to multiple questions
Be specific — avoid vague generalizations
Quantify outcomes whenever possible
Show genuine reflection and learning in failure stories
Match your stories to the company's stated values

description: Negotiating compensation and terms once an offer is extended.
tips: Always negotiate — the first offer is rarely the best
Anchor high but reasonably (15-20% above your target)
Consider total compensation: base, equity, bonus, benefits
Get the offer in writing before giving notice
Respond within the timeline given; don't ghost
